protocol_metadata.title: Pre-Declared Terminal Comparison Protocol: Job 1404931 vs Job 1404454
protocol_metadata.evaluation_domain: Shared displacement interval 0 <= u <= min(u_terminal_1404931, 0.006200 mm) using actual RP displacement u2(N_RP)

predeclared_extraction_quantities.name: Complete F-u Response Curve & Hashes
predeclared_extraction_quantities.description: Extract raw (u2, RF2) arrays for Job 1404931, compute SHA256 hash, and register array lengths.

predeclared_extraction_quantities.name: Canonical Initial Stiffness K0
predeclared_extraction_quantities.method: Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) linear regression F = K0 * u + b

predeclared_extraction_quantities.name: Peak Reaction Force Fmax and Peak Displacement u(Fmax)
First Divergence Threshold Crossings
predeclared_extraction_quantities.method: Determine exact displacement u at which |F_1404931(u) - F_1404454(u)| >= threshold

predeclared_extraction_quantities.name: Global Curve Differences over Common Interval
metrics: Discrete RMS error [N] and [% of peak load]
Continuous L2 norm [N] using trapezoidal quadrature

predeclared_extraction_quantities.name: External Work Integral Delta W_ext
predeclared_extraction_quantities.definition: W_ext = int F du evaluated via trapezoidal rule on identical common displacement interval [0, u_common]

predeclared_extraction_quantities.name: Field State Damage (SDV14) Checkpoints
field_quantities: Maximum scalar damage d_max across domain
Horizontal ligament profile d(x) along y = 0.50 mm (x in [0.40, 1.00] mm)
Transverse profile d(y) at x = 0.55 mm (y in [0.45, 0.55] mm)

predeclared_extraction_quantities.name: Crack Tip Position & Path Deviation
predeclared_extraction_quantities.definition: Crack tip defined at d = 0.90 contour along crack front; measure deviation |Delta y| from y = 0.50 mm

predeclared_extraction_quantities.name: Companion Layer Mechanical Neutrality
predeclared_extraction_quantities.definition: Verify that companion elements (with DDSDDE = 1.D-11) produce zero spurious stress and negligible reaction force contribution (< 1.0e-8 kN)

epistemic_reporting_rules: 1. Report raw numerical differences first, without applying post-hoc acceptance thresholds.
2. Any tolerance evaluation must reference prior demonstrated solver repeat precision (e.g. Job 1404454 vs 1404306: Delta K0 < 0.001%, Delta Fmax < 0.01%).
3. In the event of discrepancy in softening drop, evaluate whether it arises from the 4.167x larger displacement increment (Delta u = 4.167 um vs 1.0 um) rather than physical formulation differences.
4. Do NOT declare MODE1_RESOLUTION_EXTENSION_COMPLETE upon job completion.
